FY2000 Annual Report, official archive copy) | Consolidated income statement, balance sheet, cash flow statement, Enron Corp. FY2000 Annual Report (covers 3 years: 1998-2000 income/cash flow, 1999-2000 balance sheet; 1998 balance sheet figures corroborated via SEC EDGAR FY1999 10-K https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001024401/000102440100000002/0001024401-00-000002.txt and a contemporaneous 10-Q balance sheet comparison). AS-ORIGINALLY-FILED figures, PRE-RESTATEMENT -- Enron restated 1997-2000 financials in Nov 2001 after Chewco/JEDI/LJM special-purpose-entity consolidation issues came to light. This project tests whether the as-filed numbers showed honest distress signals, not whether fraud was detectable. EBIT = Income Before Interest, Minority Interests and Income Taxes (IBIT), the cleanest EBIT-equivalent line Enron reported. Interest Expense = "Interest and related charges, net" as reported on the income statement. Total Debt = total short- and long-term debt per Note 7 disclosure. RED FLAG: Total Assets grew 96% in 2000 (33,381->65,503) far outpacing EBIT growth of 24%, driven largely by mark-to-market "assets from price risk management activities" (~5,100 -> ~21,000) -- a major structural change visible in the as-filed numbers.
